checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Preserves all seven seconds of original footage unchanged
must.why: No video was output; only a 15 s standalone WAV was delivered. The original clip was not combined or returned.

must.item: Tense instrumental music bed audible, no singing
must.why: A 15 s WAV with sound exists, and the description says instrumental, but the mood and absence of vocals can't be verified.

must.item: Original radio calls remain present and synchronized, including 'Rook, you with me?'
must.why: The output is a music-only WAV with no original audio or video, so there is no synchronized speech.

must.item: Music perceptibly below voice during every spoken line
must.why: No mix exists; the track is standalone with no voice to sit under.

must.item: Music is audible but subordinate to speech
must.why: No mixed result. The user must do the mixing and level setting themselves.

faults.what: No video returned; the music is not added to the clip. The user must edit it themselves.
The track is 15 s against a 7 s clip, so it needs trimming and a fade-out.

summary: The agent delivered only a separate 15 s instrumental WAV and not the clip with music mixed under the radio calls, so most requirements are unmet.
